title: Smiling Girl in Backyard Garden, 1950s Deckle Edge Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of a smiling young girl standing on a sunny lawn in front of a leafy bush and wooden fence. She wears quintessential 1950s casual summer youth attire: a sleeveless patterned button-up shirt, light high-waisted shorts, white crew socks, and two-tone saddle shoes. The photograph has scalloped or deckle-edge borders characteristic of mid-20th-century family snapshots.
